briefing.summary: Pre-flight complete at Bankstown. ATIS information Mike received. Ready to copy IFR clearance to Coffs Harbour.

challenge.prompt: Make the initial call to Bankstown Tower to request your IFR clearance.
challenge.expectedText: Bankstown Tower, Lima Echo Foxtrot, IFR clearance to Coffs Harbour, information Mike.

elements.label: Addressed station
elements.hint: Addressed station goes first per AIP GEN 3.4 initial-call format.

elements.label: Request type
elements.hint: Say 'IFR clearance' — distinguishes from a VFR request.

elements.label: ATIS code confirmation
elements.hint: Confirm the ATIS so Tower doesn't have to ask.

challenge.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4: addressed station, callsign, request type with destination, ATIS code.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Initial-call format for an IFR clearance request.
